critical_code_review_comments: email_auth._issue_code: uses CLERK_SECRET_KEY as HMAC key for storing code hashes. Secure, but note that rotating the Clerk secret would invalidate all in-flight OTPs; acceptable but worth documenting.

email_auth.send_code purpose='login' leaks user existence via is_new boolean in the response — intentional per spec (frontend needs to decide register vs login copy), but is an enumeration surface. Rate-limited by RESEND_SECONDS and MAX_PER_HOUR, so OK.
email_auth.send_code purpose='reset' returns 404 '此信箱尚未註冊' which is also an enumeration surface. Common tradeoff; left as-is.

server.wallet_topups (L850): on each GET, pending-past-expiry rows are mutated inline with an await inside the for-loop; this does per-doc round-trips. For a wallet listing capped at 100 this is fine but a single bulk update_many would be cleaner.

email_auth._primary_email returns '' when no addresses; _issue_code then would use empty email and ultimately 400 '帳號未綁定信箱' is only raised in me_send_code — good — but me_change_password calls _consume_code with email ='' without the same empty guard. Low-risk because any authenticated user without an email cannot have reached send-code.
AuthModal / ForgotPassword — forgot flow uses auth-tab-email key name 'forgot-tab-email' and 'forgot-tab-phone'; naming consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: email login, password login w/o 2FA, forgot password, account pw change, wallet topups listing on desktop and mobile)
